$comment: CANONICAL cDot brand definition. Single source of truth. src/styles/tokens.css derives from this, and `npm run brand:check` verifies the sibling repos still agree. If you change a value here, run the check and update whatever it flags.

brand.note: Tailwind primary-500 in the sibling repos, and the fill colour inside the logo SVG. Never write this as #556AFD - that transposition is a known typo.

fonts.note: Corrected from Inter / Darker Grotesque, which no consumer has ever shipped - cdot.world and cdot.app both load Geist and Host Grotesk via @fontsource-variable. This file is the canonical definition, so it described fonts nobody used. The pair is shared across both sites on purpose: they are one product seen from two sides, and light versus dark is what distinguishes them.
